requirements.title: Electron Present F uses native setFullScreen
requirements.description: On Mac Electron, Present F enters/exits fullscreen via main-process BrowserWindow.setFullScreen, not HTML requestFullscreen.

requirements.title: Stronger setSimpleFullScreen fallback
requirements.description: If the system menu bar still shows after native fullscreen (or native FS cannot be used), apply setSimpleFullScreen while preserving easy exit.

requirements.title: F and Escape always exit
requirements.description: F and Escape always restore windowed Present; no hard kiosk that blocks easy exit.

requirements.title: No auto-fullscreen on open
requirements.description: Present does not enter fullscreen automatically when the window opens.

requirements.title: Window-scoped only, no display picker
requirements.description: Only existing Present windows are fullscreened on the display they already occupy; no display-picker UI.

requirements.title: Browser Present keeps HTML fullscreen
requirements.description: Browser / Remix Present continues to use HTML requestFullscreen / exitFullscreen only.

requirements.title: Release notes bullet
requirements.description: Shipping release notes mention the Mac Present fullscreen reliability fix in user-facing language.

todos.content: Add Electron IPC + preload APIs so Present can request enter/exit fullscreen on its own BrowserWindow (macOS native setFullScreen; no HTML-only path on Electron).
todos.notes: QA: presentFullscreen.cjs + main IPC enter/exit/toggle/is + preload APIs; electron-main.regression asserts sender-scoped handlers.

todos.content: On Electron Present, F enters/exits via the bridge (native setFullScreen). Do not call requestFullscreen on Electron. Browser Present keeps HTML requestFullscreen.
todos.notes: QA: Present.fullscreen.test — Electron F → toggleFullscreen, never requestFullscreen; browser F still requestFullscreen.

todos.content: If after native fullscreen the Mac menu bar still remains visible (or native FS fails), fall back to setSimpleFullScreen (or equivalent) while preserving easy exit.
todos.notes: QA: presentFullscreen.test — native-failed and menu-bar-visible paths call setSimpleFullScreen; exit clears both.

todos.content: F and Escape always leave fullscreen (native or fallback) and restore the windowed Present; no hard kiosk lock.
todos.notes: QA: Escape → exitFullscreen bridge; exitPresentFullscreen clears native+simple; no setKiosk in main.

todos.content: Opening a Present window stays windowed; fullscreen only after operator F (or explicit UI that maps to the same path).
todos.notes: QA: openPresentSessionWindow block has no setFullScreen/setSimpleFullScreen; regression test asserts.

todos.content: Fullscreen applies only to existing Present BrowserWindows on the display they already occupy; no display-picker UI.
todos.notes: QA: IPC uses BrowserWindow.fromWebContents(event.sender) only; no display-picker UI.

todos.content: Add automated coverage for Electron bridge behavior (enter/exit native vs fallback routing, browser still uses HTML FS) at unit/IPC mock level Jack can extend.
todos.notes: QA: presentFullscreen.test.js + Present.fullscreen.test.tsx + electron-main.regression; full suite 45/300 PASS.

todos.content: Release-notes bullet for Mac Present fullscreen reliability; short note that System Settings menu-bar mode can still affect Never, with the app fallback covering stubborn cases.
